note: Known measurement devices. A host matches a profile when every entry of match_all is found (case-insensitive; a list means any of its words) in the CPU model, DMI product/board, device-tree model or host name, and the architecture agrees. The most specific profile wins. 'class' is what scenario.json lists under device_classes; 'kernels_validated' are kernels already seen on that machine (a new kernel only raises a warning: record it as a new (machine, kernel) pair).
